title: 第5章 鱼换物资第6章 清北大学
content_zh:
张昊宇集中精神，用意念控制着鱼群，每次只收一立方范围内的鱼到空间河里。
他每隔几分钟就用意念往鱼钩上挂一条鱼，忙得那叫一个“热火朝天”！这会儿，身后已经围着十几个人了！
神识观察着，发现没有鱼群过来了。便将神识进入空间观察一下，河里已经有一千多条鱼了。
十斤以上的鱼有二十条，七八斤的鱼有63条，一到五斤的鱼有三百多条，一斤以下的鱼更是有一千多条呢……
钓到外面的鱼，一斤到三斤左右的有八条，四到六斤的有二十四条，七八斤的有五条，最后还钓上来一条一斤左右的鲫鱼。
“收拾好渔具，不钓了！”
这时候，周围的人七嘴八舌地问：“小同志，你的鱼卖不卖呀？”
“不卖，个人买卖可是违法的，你们不知道吗？难道想让我犯法啊？”
其中一个人开口，“对呀，个人不能买卖！我用票跟你换吧，我有两斤全国粮票，跟你换一条四五斤的鱼，你看行不？”
张昊宇看着那个人，翻了个白眼，“你看我像傻子吗？”
旁边有人插嘴，“这位同志，你也太不厚道了吧！想占小孩子便宜啊？
全国粮票黑市上也就五毛钱一斤，两斤全国粮票才一块钱，想换四五斤的鱼，也太过分了。”
那人有点尴尬，还强词夺理，“收购站收鱼两毛钱左右一斤，我怎么就占便宜了？”
这时又有人道：“收购站收鱼两三毛钱左右一斤，没错，但是个人去买鱼得要票吧？
就算有票，也不一定能买到鱼啊！何况还是刚刚钓上来的活鱼。
黑市上，两斤以上的鱼得四五毛钱一斤呢，死鱼都不一定能买到！”
那人又辩解，“黑市上是犯法的！”
这时候，突然传来一个声音：“卖给我们不犯法！”大家都循着声音看过去，原来是个小胖子！
嘿，一个二十几岁的小胖子！这年月，胖子可不多见呐！小胖子蹦蹦跳跳地来到张昊宇面前。
笑嘻嘻地，“兄弟，我是清北大学后勤采购员，我叫钱大宝。”

我们有计划外物资采购权，不违法的！你的鱼卖给我吧。
“我看了一下，你钓到的鱼大部分都两斤以上的，我给你六毛钱一斤，还能给你开收购证明，你看行不？”
要钱要票都成！或者烟酒、糖茶我也能搞到。
张昊宇心中一喜，“大学虽然不是啥权力机构，但人脉广啊！”
这年代大学生毕业就是干部！跟大学做交易，那可真是个不错的选择。
张昊宇问：“卖给你真不犯法？收购证明有用吗？”
小胖子一听，眼睛一亮，忙说：“不犯法，收购证明绝对有效！”
小胖子趁热打铁，“兄弟，你就帮帮忙吧，现在荤腥严重短缺，师生们都缺营养，学习累脑子！长期缺营养会出问题的。”
“好吧！这些鱼咋拿呢，我没东西装鱼啊！”小胖子一听，乐了，“我有麻袋和三轮车！你稍等会儿。”
小胖子撒腿就跑向三轮车，从车上拿来两个麻袋，两人一起把鱼装进麻袋，搬到三轮车上。
“我叫钱大宝，兄弟你咋称呼？”
“我叫张昊宇！我十五岁，你叫我小宇就行！”
“这位小兄弟，我26岁，你要是不介意，叫我钱哥或者大宝哥，我叫你小宇……”
“那咱先把鱼送回大学，免得鱼死了！”
“好嘞！”两人有说有笑地边走边聊，来到清北大学。
content_en:
Zhang Haoyu concentrated his mind and used his mind to control the school of fish, collecting only one cubic meter of fish into the space river at a time.
He used his mind to hang a fish on the hook every few minutes, and he was so busy that he was "in full swing"! At this moment, there were already more than a dozen people surrounding him!
Observing with his spiritual consciousness, he found that no fish were coming. Then he put his consciousness into the space and observed that there were already more than a thousand fish in the river.
There are 20 fish weighing more than ten kilograms, 63 fish weighing seven or eight kilograms, more than 300 fish weighing one to five kilograms, and more than a thousand fish weighing less than one kilogram...
Among the fish caught outside, there were eight fish weighing one to three kilograms, twenty-four fish weighing four to six kilograms, five fish weighing seven or eight kilograms, and finally a crucian carp weighing about one kilogram was caught.
"Pack up your fishing gear and stop fishing!"
At this time, people around asked all around: "Little comrade, do you want to sell your fish?"
"No selling, personal trading is illegal, don't you know? Do you want me to break the law?"
One of the people said, "That's right, individuals can't buy or sell! Let me exchange my tickets with you. I have two kilograms of national food stamps, and I can exchange them with you for a fish that weighs four or five kilograms. Do you think that's okay?"
Zhang Haoyu looked at that person and rolled his eyes, "Do you think I am a fool?"
Someone next to me interrupted, "Comrade, you are too unkind! Do you want to take advantage of the children?
National food stamps on the black market are only 50 cents per catty, and two catties of national food stamps are only one yuan. It is too much to exchange for four or five catties of fish. "
The man was a little embarrassed, and said with forceful words, "The buying station charges about 20 cents per catty for fish, how can I take advantage?"
At this time, someone else said: "The buying station charges about 20 to 30 cents per catty for fish. That's right, but if you want to buy fish individually, you need a ticket, right?"
Even if you have a ticket, you may not be able to buy fish! What's more, it was a live fish that had just been caught.
On the black market, fish weighing more than two kilograms costs 40 to 50 cents per kilogram, and you may not even be able to buy dead fish! "
The man argued again, "It's illegal to be on the black market!"
At this time, a voice suddenly came: "It's not illegal to sell it to us!" Everyone followed the voice and looked over, and it turned out to be a little fat man!
Hey, a fat guy in his twenties! Fat people are rare these days! The little fat man jumped up to Zhang Haoyu.
With a smile, he said, "Brother, I am a logistics buyer at Qingbei University. My name is Qian Dabao."
We have the right to purchase unplanned materials, and it is not illegal! Sell ​​me your fish.
"I took a look and found that most of the fish you caught weighed more than two kilograms. I'll give you 60 cents per kilogram and issue a purchase certificate for you. Do you think that's okay?"
All you need is money or tickets! Or I can get tobacco, alcohol, sugar and tea.
Zhang Haoyu was delighted, "Although the university is not a powerful institution, it has a wide network of contacts!"
In this era, college graduates become cadres! Making a deal with the university would be a really good choice.
Zhang Haoyu asked: "Is it really illegal to sell it to you? Is the acquisition certificate useful?"
When the little fat man heard this, his eyes lit up and he hurriedly said: "It's not illegal, the acquisition has proven to be absolutely effective!"
The little fat man struck while the iron was hot, "Brother, please help. There is a serious shortage of meat now. Teachers and students are all lacking nutrition. Studying is tiring their brains! Long-term lack of nutrition will cause problems."
"Okay! How to get these fish? I don't have anything to put the fish in!" The little fat man was happy when he heard this, "I have a sack and a tricycle! Just wait a moment."
The little fat man ran to the tricycle and took two sacks from the car. Together they put the fish into the sacks and moved them to the tricycle.
"My name is Qian Dabao, brother, what do you call me?"
"My name is Zhang Haoyu! I'm fifteen years old, you can just call me Xiaoyu!"
"Little brother, I'm 26 years old. If you don't mind, call me Brother Qian or Brother Dabao. I'll call you Xiaoyu..."
"Then let's take the fish back to the university first, before it dies!"
"Okay!" The two of them walked and laughed, chatting, and arrived at Qingbei University.
